name: Temporal Attribution Protocol V1

steps.name: memory_correctness
steps.input: gold temporal fact + recovered semantic state
steps.decision: inspect whether the recovered semantic state preserves the temporal relation and entity fact

steps.name: generation_correctness
steps.decision: inspect whether the answer faithfully verbalizes the recovered state

steps.name: scorer_alignment
steps.decision: inspect whether the official score matches the semantic diagnosis

freeze_boundary: Scorer mismatches are treated as measurement issues, not SRP memory failures.
